Introduction

Kim Hyeonbin is a South Korean idol under Cube Entertainment. He was first known for appearing in the hit survival program Produce X 101, and was eliminated at 30th place. He later debuted as a member of the boy group NOWZ (formerly NOWADAYS) on April 2, 2024, with the single album "NOWADAYS".
